text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: —It's finally here! The autumn of sports!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Today is the 1st Student Volunteer Athletic Meet~!
Everyone, you're all geared up and ready, right?!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Of course!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... My training is complete for today!
I polished my whole set of kendo armor
until it was sparkling clean, you know!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? Kendo?
Isn't today the casual baseball tournament?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Sandlot baseball? I was under the impression
we would be holding a multi-discipline board-breaking tournament...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Oh? I thought it was just gonna be a normal sports festival...
Like with bread-eating races and stuff.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...Whaaaaat!?
I forgot to choose an event!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Oh no! At this rate, the whole tournament
is going to be ruined!
—I'm completely fine!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Let's do this as planned!
All the hard work everyone put in for today—
there's no way we're letting it go to waste!!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ticket-zo... But everyone brought completely
different gear...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: No need to worry! At times like this, we just combine everyone's power to push through!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
C-Combine?! Y-You mean, what kind
of event are we actually doing today?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Base Kendo Board-Breaking Challenge Sports Day!!
That's what we're going with!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I... I get it! You mean we combine everyone's specialties
to create a brand new sport right here today!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
However... is such a thing even possible?
We'd have to build the rules from scratch...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
We'll be fine if we brainstorm together!
Like, hitting a ball with a shinai and aiming for the beanbag toss basket, or—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, in that case, if we write the items on the balls beforehand,
couldn't it double as a scavenger hunt race?"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm, working together to overcome a crisis...!
Now that is a true page out of the youth of mid-autumn!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Mmh...! W-Well, when you put it like that,
it actually sounds like a brilliant idea... Mmmgh!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, everyone calm down?!
We definitely need to rethink this plan~~~!!"
